a.definition: used before a singular countable noun when referring to one person or thing that is not specifically identified

an.definition: used before a singular countable noun beginning with a vowel sound when the person or thing is not specifically identified

in.definition: inside a place, area, or period of time

or.definition: used to connect alternatives or choices

be.definition: to exist, occur, or have a particular state or quality

are.definition: a present-tense form of the verb 'be', used with you, we, they, and plural subjects

at.definition: used to show a particular place, point, time, or activity

as.definition: used to describe a role, comparison, manner, or situation

was.definition: the past-tense form of 'be' used with I, he, she, and it

can.definition: used to say that someone or something is able to do something

us.definition: the object form of 'we', used for the speaker and one or more other people

has.definition: the third-person singular present form of 'have'

more.definition: a greater amount, number, or degree

about.definition: on the subject of something; also used to mean approximately
